summary.intent: Work through the v1 hardening plan for the callisto release tool in parallel lanes (SYS-RETRY fix, test debt, docs refresh, init/derive refactors, SYS-NAPI, canonical report ids, CLI arg changes, edition 2024, schemars migration, HEAD-binding fix), keeping PRs mergeable and stacked sensibly.
summary.outcome: Opened and, with the user's merges, landed a large set of PRs (#202-#205, #274-#288 and others), each with local `just ci` green. The last items, an A2 HEAD-binding fix PR and an E176 operation-id Display cleanup, were committed and pushed. Closed mistakenly opened PR #201 and moved the plan to a git-excluded local file.

repo: Local tracking and handoff plans (NEXT-WORK.md) live in `.claude/plans/` and are excluded via `.git/info/exclude`; they must never be committed or put in a PR.

`just ci` is the gate. Run it via a script that writes an `exit=` line to a log, and read that line, because the background-task notification only reports the wrapper's exit code and can say 0 while CI failed (it hid exit=1, 100 and 101 several times).
Each new error code adds a row to `docs/errors.md` and bumps the total-code count, so concurrent PRs that add codes conflict there. Rebase one at a time after each merge.
Native PR stacks are made with `gh stack link`; PRs touching the same files (status.rs, version.rs/identity.rs/schemas) should be stacked, others left independent.

Reports (`status`, `version`, `snapshot`, `matrix`) now use `ecosystem/name` ids with schemaVersion 2; `add` and `matrix --package` reject bare names with E317, so tests and fixtures must use qualified specs.
schemars 1.x emits JSON Schema 2020-12 (`$defs`, `const`) and takes the schema from wire types, so wire types need `JsonSchema` derives.
Insta snapshot characterization tests before a move/split refactor (init templates, derive.rs) then proving snapshots fail under a mutation was the pattern used for R3/R5b.
The generated matrix workflow template runs under macOS bash without `mapfile`; use portable loops. The intent omits `artifactSlots` when empty, so jq must tolerate null.
Hosted Ubuntu CI caught a verdaccio real-registry test passing a bare name that passed locally.

code.finding: SYS-RETRY: local selection now observes releases already tagged at HEAD across all operations; a tag on an older commit still settles without contacting providers; previews without an origin push URL skip observation.
Tag observation must read only the object type, not the annotation message, since multi-paragraph or signed tag messages broke the for-each-ref parsing.
SYS-NAPI: napi roster is now derived per intent package via `callisto matrix`, and placement reads the plan job's napi_dirs output.
New A2 module detecting a published version from a later commit so the local route refuses instead of releasing HEAD.

friction: Mistakenly opened PR #201 for a local-only plan file and had to close it.
Misleading task-notification 'exit code 0' repeatedly masked real CI failures.
Sandbox restrictions forced many workarounds (heredocs, inline env, signed commits, cargo fetch, gh TLS).
Parallel PRs off main produced seven pairwise conflicts, mostly docs/errors.md count bumps, plus a 35-file edition PR that had to be regenerated.
#281 failed hosted Ubuntu CI and then again after #274 merged, due to bare package specs in new tests.
A plain `git push` silently did nothing because the local branch name differed from the remote's.
Dependabot #275 failed until the schemars major was migrated.
open_items: Branch cleanup: stale remote branches (docs/next-work-plan, docs/spec-rewrite, fix/native-resolution) and ~35 local branches need per-branch user approval before deletion.
W1 real-service credential check needs a decision on where it runs in CI.
D01 decision blocks SYS-MATURIN and W9; W10 needs decisions on distinct target edges and Python dev group cascade; W11 needs credentials and an approved run.
A5 registry-repository check, floating v1 action tag, Intel-mac and aarch64-linux binaries, T08 selection, T12 verification remain.
Fuzz targets are only compile-checked, never run under libFuzzer; E176 never reproduced against a real registry.
Python dev-table warning was dropped as too noisy for uv workspaces.
Post-1.0 OIDC trusted publishing; user acts remain to accept ADR 12 and cut 0.12.0.
Follow-up edits for T08-RETRY references after #202 merges.
The final A2 HEAD-binding PR and E176 operation Display PR need hosted CI confirmation and merging.
